automated_profile.interpretation: Descriptive language profile only; not a discovery, error, or research-quality rate.

verification_requirements: Resolve every abbreviated commit in claim_lineages.csv against the named repository.
Read the claim and adjudication artifacts rather than inferring scientific status from commit subjects.
Verify timestamps with git show --format=fuller and retain timezone offsets.
Treat the cross-repository cases as propagation failures, not local Gnosis correction latencies.
Independently verify the entity-criterion algebra and units.
known_limitations: The lexical dictionaries were designed after observing the corpus.
Commit practices can combine or split conceptual research events.
The nine named lineages are purposively selected, not a random sample.
One reviewer performed the current manual coding; blinded replication and inter-rater agreement remain future work.
The snapshot ends before later public-repository changes.
